other_conditions: The applicant must be a student.
The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant must have qualified in any national competitive examination such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, or NDA.
The applicant must have been admitted to an IIT/NIT (via JEE), a government college in Madhya Pradesh for NEET (MBBS only), AIIMS, NLU (via CLAT), or NDA (via UPSC).
The applicant's Aadhaar must be linked to the bank account.
The applicant must have the receipt of admission to the institute.
Registration of a beneficiary profile is mandatory before applying for the scheme.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹50,000 to students whose parental income is up to ₹3 lakh, and ₹25,000 to those with parental income above ₹3 lakh.
